visuals: A quaint English countryside village under a light rainfall with people holding umbrellas and green rolling hills in the background.
script: England is known for having more rainy days than sunny ones, so don’t get too far from your umbrella! It has green hills, cloudy skies, and mild summers that won’t melt your ice cream.

visuals: A scenic view of the Lake District in England with calm lakes, green mountains, and the Scafell Pike peak in the distance.
script: The Lake District has deep, shiny lakes and Scafell Pike, the tallest mountain in England. It’s perfect for hikers and sheep!

visuals: A vibrant red rose national symbol of England displayed in front of a historic parchment scroll.
script: Guess what symbolizes England? The red rose! It’s not just pretty, it’s historic and royal.

visuals: A red fox and a hedgehog in a green English field during a sunny afternoon.
script: And when you stroll in the countryside, you might spot a red fox or a spiky little hedgehog. So cute!

visuals: A tiny dormouse curled up and sleeping under a leaf in the English countryside.
script: Keep your eyes peeled for the rare dormouse too, it naps for most of the year!

visuals: A classic London scene in England featuring Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, and a red double-decker bus on a bridge.
script: Speaking of amazing places: London is the capital of England. With Big Ben chiming and red double-decker buses zooming by, it’s also the place where the royal family lives.

visuals: The grand facade of Buckingham Palace in London, England, with the King's Guard in red uniforms and tall black hats standing at the gates.
script: To be more precise, Buckingham Palace is the residence of the King of England. Yes! England has a royal family! and something called a constitutional monarchy, which means the king is part of the tradition, but a Parliament helps run the country.

visuals: The Old Trafford soccer stadium in Manchester, England, with a modern music stage in the foreground.
script: England has many famous cities! Manchester has top football teams and is known for bands like Oasis.

visuals: The historic Albert Dock in Liverpool, England, with its brick warehouses and musical note symbols nearby.
script: And Liverpool is The Beatles’ hometown and a super busy port next to the Irish Sea.

visuals: A pleasant afternoon at the Covent Garden market in London, England, with pedestrians walking past shops and street performers.
script: About 56 million people live in England, that’s slightly more than California!

visuals: A traditional plate of English fish and chips wrapped in newspaper, served at a seaside table with the ocean in the background.
script: Now let's talk about food! Fish and chips is a seaside snack superstar: crispy, tasty, and wrapped in paper.

visuals: An elegant English afternoon tea set on a table with tiered trays of finger sandwiches, scones, and a porcelain teapot.
script: Afternoon tea with dainty sandwiches and cakes is a lovely treat, especially in London.

visuals: A cozy dining table in an English home with a family enjoying a traditional Sunday roast with gravy and Yorkshire pudding.
script: And on Sundays, families gather for roast dinners with gravy and veggies. Pass the Yorkshire pudding, please!

visuals: English performers in white clothes and hats with bells and handkerchiefs performing a traditional Morris dance at a village fair.
script: Now let’s talk tunes. At school fairs, people sometimes dress up and perform Morris dances with bells and sticks!

visuals: The massive Glastonbury Festival in England at night with colorful stage lights and a large crowd under the stars.
script: Every summer, the Glastonbury Festival turns the fields of southwest England into one giant music party. Rock on!

visuals: A historic black-and-white image of the 1966 World Cup final at Wembley Stadium in England with the team celebrating with the trophy.
script: Here’s a proud footie fact: in 1966, England won their only FIFA World Cup. The final was right in Wembley Stadium, cheers all around!

visuals: English soccer star David Beckham celebrating a goal on the pitch.
script: Football rules, and England has tons of talent like David Beckham.

visuals: English soccer player Harry Kane in his national team jersey kicking a ball.
script: Or Harry Kane.

visuals: English author J.K. Rowling writing at a desk with a stack of Harry Potter books beside her.
script: Love books? J.K. Rowling, who wrote the Harry Potter series, comes from England too. Magic and goals, a great combo!

visuals: A historic English factory from the industrial era with a large steam engine and gears in motion.
script: Want a fun fuct? England helped invent the steam engine, so you could say this country… really got things rolling!
